card.name: Bushels, quarts and pints after numbers
card.fires_on: Old-style volume units (bushel, quart, pint) right after a number or "a", including the split pieces "bush|el", "qu|arts" and the abbreviation "bu".

modes.label: Bushels in crop yields
modes.description: Bushel unit or its abbreviation after a grain price or yield figure.
modes.example: the Iowa average corn price in 1998/99 was $1.87 per bush<<el>>.

modes.label: Quarts and pints of liquid
modes.description: Quart or pint after an amount of water or fluid in directions.
modes.example: The total volume of liquid required for colon cleansing (using two bottles) is 3 qu<<arts>>.

card.plain: It marks the unit word (bushel, quart, pint) that follows an amount of grain or liquid.
